summary_en: Gigantin Bio organic fertilizer made by aerobic fermentation of poultry manure at Ussuriyskaya Poultry Farm in Primorsky Krai. The fertilizer is registered with the Russian Ministry of Agriculture (valid to October 2033) and a full 40-foot container was shipped to Vietnam in December 2025. A second producer offers OrganicaFK granulated organic fertilizer made from seaweed, fish meal and natural minerals.
meta_html: Potential buyers Agricultural distributors and commercial growers.Documents and specifications are reviewed for each inquiry.
supplier_region: Ussuriyskaya Poultry Farm and Fokino, Primorsky Krai
certificates: Russian state registration of Gigantin Bio, product analysis and the 2025 bill of lading to Vietnam, on request
moq: One 40-foot container for Gigantin Bio, about 26 t net in 25 kg bags
packaging: Gigantin Bio in big bags or 25 kg bags. OrganicaFK in 20 to 50 kg bags and small retail packs
incoterms: CFR or EXW (Gigantin Bio), EXW or CIF (OrganicaFK)

import_notes.text: BAFS registers organic soil amendment products and producers and issues organic input importation permits

summary_en: BIOTORF, a peat-based organic biostimulant paste with humic substances. One litre of paste is mixed with four litres of water to make a working concentrate for seed soaking, foliar spraying and root feeding. The producer reports field trials in 2024 on cotton in Uzbekistan and on bananas, coffee, maize and papaya in Uganda and Equatorial Guinea.
meta_html: Potential buyers Fertilizer importers, agricultural distributors and commercial farms.Results may vary and require independent verification under local conditions.
certificates: Russian technical specification TU 039010-01-90160664-2025, English safety data sheet and 2025 laboratory reports (pathogens, pesticides, humic substances), on request
moq: Free 2-litre sample for trials. Commercial minimum on request
packaging: 1-tonne IBC containers. One tonne of paste gives about five tonnes of concentrate

import_notes.text: The regulator depends on the product: BAFS for organic soil amendments, FPA for other fertilizers

summary_en: Frozen pork cuts, bone-in hams and shoulders, boneless pork, liver, other edible offal and pork fat from a vertically integrated pig producer in the Mikhailovsky district of Primorsky Krai with six pig farms and its own feed production. The decision is pending, and no pork can be shipped from this plant until it is accredited.
